model: A selected Google marker ran a 2s pulse that interpolated box-shadow. Overseas markers also painted a drop-shadow and transitioned transform for 200ms. The pulse and the shadow are gone, and hover scale changes in one frame.

noise.rule: 120 is 2s times 60fps. 12 is round(200ms * 60fps / 1000). 60 is one shadowed marker times 60 frames. Not a sampled compositor trace.
